mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 0.25% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below -0.5% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 0.4% month-over-month and UNRATE above 5% signals strong labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending but also increases wage inflation, resulting in a net positive effect on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their respective 12-month moving averages signals weakening housing and overall demand, which reduces corporate revenue and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% for six consecutive months signals an extended period of monetary accommodation, which supports corporate borrowing and investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in INDPRO above 0.7% and RSAFS above 2% YoY signals a supply-side expansion with increased corporate investment, which boosts earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.
